english.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg
english.objective: Shayla Nightbreeze on the road outside of Darnassus wants you to bring her 15 Gnarlpine Fangs.
english.detail:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.

english.title: Coming to Terms
english.objective: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
english.detail:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

english.title: Coming to Terms
english.objective: Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.
english.progress: Coming to terms with this new life is not easy for any of us. For some it's simply more than they can bear.
english.complete:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, <name>.

english.title: Murlocs at the Gates
english.objective: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
english.detail:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

english.title: Murlocs at the Gates
english.objective: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
english.progress: These murlocs just don't quit!
english.complete: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.

english.title: My First Alchemy Set
english.objective: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.detail:
Erm... 'Ello, mister/miss. I'm not supposed to talk to strangers, but... Hey, what are those shiny bottles sticking out of your backpack for? Are you an alchemist? That's so cool!

When I grow up, I want to be an alchemist too. Daddy won't let me play with any of his herbs; too dangerous, he says.

Well, I want to start learning now. Could you maybe get some supplies for me, pretty please?

english.objective: Bring 5 Empty Vials, 5 Silverleaf, and 5 Peacebloom to the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.progress: 'Ello again! Did you bring back alchemy stuff?
english.complete:
Oh my gosh! Look at these! Did you pick the herbs yourself?

Wow, thanks mister, I am going to see what I can make with these right now! Do you want to watch?

english.title: My First Real Potion
english.objective: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.detail:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.

english.objective: Gather 3 Murloc Eyes for the young, aspiring alchemist inside the barn of Moonbrook in Westfall.
english.progress: Don't worry about me, I'm a big girl. I can take care of myself. Just don't tell anyone I am hiding here, it's our little secret.
english.complete:
You brought me murloc eyes! I am so excited for my first REAL potion I can't breathe!

I snuck out and grabbed a few more herbs while you were away and found some empty vials downstairs. Um... you can do the mixing this time.

<The child watches enthusiastically you mix the ingredients, but her nose crumples as you add the eyes. The concoction takes on a sickly orange in mere seconds.>

Wow! See, I was right. I wouldn't drink that, but here's my recipe if you wanted to make more. Come back sometime!

english.title: Harmony in Balance
english.objective: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.

english.title: Harmony in Balance
english.objective: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
english.complete:
Thank you for your service to Zephras, young <class>.

The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.

english.objective: Slay 6 Roiling Winds and 7 Al'Aketh Converts in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, <Class>?

english.progress: Is it done?
english.complete: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.

english.objective: Speak with Illaya Amberwind and Coriella Calmbreeze in Shen'dar Village.
english.detail:
You've got that "Windshaper" air about you. Something about how I can feel a tiny bit of static on my skin when near someone spirit-touched that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident Windshaper elder, Illaya Amberwind. She's just outside, near the center of town.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

english.complete:
Checked in with Illaya then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Everyone here is well aware that we've got bigger problems than their quibbles.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands and I've got a bandit problem that I was hoping you could help me with.

english.title: Hippogryph Harassment
english.objective: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

english.title: Hippogryph Harassment
english.objective: Slay 8 Hippogryph Youths, 6 Hippogryph Protectors and a Hippogryph Matriarch in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: Hippogryphs are very proud creatures. It's probably the noise from the wagon trains that rile them up and cause them to attack. Whatever the reason for the attacks, dead caravaneers aren't something that we can ignore.
english.complete: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.

english.title: The Criminal Element
english.objective: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.

english.title: The Criminal Element
english.objective: Kill 10 Highlands Bandits and their leader, "Badwind" Bennic in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.complete:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.

english.objective: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.

english.objective: Slay 6 Al'Aketh Brutes, 4 Al'Aketh Neophytes, and Malduko Cloudcrush in Thendal Grove.
english.progress: I suspect that seeing a few of their fellows bleeding on the ground will do wonders to dissuade any zealous ambitions these thugs might have had.
english.complete:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, <class>. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.

english.title: The Gift of Skysight
english.objective: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
english.detail:
As a Windshaper, you have the ability to use the sacred skysight gifted to us by the elemental spirits. Travel to the standing stones to the northeast of the village. Find the elemental convergence there and use your gift.

You'll find that you may draw upon the skysight anywhere, but its boon is much more powerful if you do so in the presence of an elemental convergence. You may at times receive other bits of wisdom from the spirits that are drawn to such places of power, as well.

english.title: The Gift of Skysight
english.objective: Use your Skysight racial ability at the Elemental Convergence in Thendal Grove.
english.complete:
Like a muscle, your skysight must be exercised if you hope to grow stronger in the gift. Leveraging your skysight to bridge the distance between the mortal and the spiritual may prove invaluable to you in your adventures.

You'd do well to remember what you've learned here today. Our ability to use our gifts to hear what the elements tell us could be the key to our survival.

english.objective: Slay 4 Al'Aketh Healers and 8 Al'Aketh Brawlers in the Gustberry Lowlands.
english.detail:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.

This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, <Class>.

english.objective: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
english.detail:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.

english.objective: Find the forge hidden in the Deadmines, and plant the Extra-Destructive Explosives nearby. Then, meet up with Alba Fairmoon at the Deadmines exit.
english.detail:
The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully, with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.

english.objective: Slay 7 Al'Aketh Guardians, 7 Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and 7 Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, <Class>.

english.title: Exploring the Horde
english.objective: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
english.detail:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.

english.complete:
So you have returned. I hope that you learned much in your journey.

It is my understanding that your people are still establishing themselves in Mulgore. While you wait for them, I'd encourage you to explore the territory around Orgrimmar. The Barrens in particular is always in need of eager adventurers like yourself.

english.objective: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
english.detail:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

english.objective: Confront Belathaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
english.complete:
Wait--what?! Belathaan... is dead? 

<Ayessa listens as you give your account of what occurred.> 

The High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?

Pay this no mind, <name>. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.

english.detail:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <Class>.

english.title: Confront Lorthuna
english.objective: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with High Priestess Lorthuna.
english.complete:
I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.
english.detail:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, <class>.

english.title: Bugged
english.objective: Kill Skyhoppers in Valanaar until you've eliminated 8 Enchanted Skyhoppers.
english.detail:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.

english.complete: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.

english.title: Exploring the Alliance
english.objective: Speak with Randal Emerson in Stormwind Keep to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with King Magni Bronzebeard, High Tinker Mekkatorque, and Tyrande Whisperwind.
english.detail:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.

english.complete:
Ah, you are back.

I hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.

While you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.

english.title: Meddlesome Mages
english.objective: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them.

I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.

english.title: Meddlesome Mages
english.objective: Slay 6 High Order Apprentices in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: Do what must be done, <class>.
english.complete:
Direct conflict with our shen'dorei brothers and sisters only weakens us as a people, but decisive action must at times be taken to prevent greater tragedy.

The mages of the High Order have zero regard for the consequences of their magical meddling. The forces that bind our island are fragile and vulnerable and all it could take is one thoughtless action to destroy our home.

english.title: A Magical Affront
english.objective: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
The recent emergence of the leylines on the surface of Zephras has been profound for our order. We have more direct and tangible access to the energies that permeate this place and it has increased our understanding of said magic greatly.

The Windshapers, however, view these emergences as scars on the land that must be "healed". This is an affront to our order and is something we simply cannot abide.

Go to the leyline in the forest to the southwest and drive off the Windshapers you find there.

english.title: A Magical Affront
english.objective: Slay 6 Windshaper Novice Seers in Shen'dar Highlands.
english.complete:
Sometimes I find it hard to distinguish between the blind zealotry of the Al'Aketh cult, and the stubborn refusal of the Windshapers to change.

If they truly believed the winds would guide us, they should be sensing the direction the winds are blowing and flow with them rather than against them.

english.title: Strength and Mercy
english.objective: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.detail:
You have come to me in hopes of learning to take a shape of strength. I have a task for you, though it lies heavy on my heart.

My mate, Ur'endra, has lost herself to madness and has begun to attack her own kin. Without the magic of the winds, many creatures have begun to lose themselves... Ur'endra included. She makes her lair in a cave to the west of here, in the bluffs along the border between the Shen'dar Highlands and the Gustberry Lowlands.

End her suffering and I shall grant you my blessing.

english.title: Strength and Mercy
english.objective: Find and kill Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands.
english.progress: What I ask of you is no easy task. Take heart in your courage and return to me when the deed is done.
english.complete:
The agony I feel over her loss is immeasurable, but it is what is necessary for the balance. You have demonstrated a resolve to persevere, even when a terrible price is asked.

You have done well, <class>. I shall grant you the blessing to take on the shape of my kin. Be a beacon for those that lack the strength to persevere and a defender of those in need.

Go now, and embrace the way of the claw, child.

english.detail:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!

english.detail:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.

english.complete:

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.

english.objective: Slay 10 Dark Iron Spies in Dun Morogh.
english.detail:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.

english.progress: How'd it go? Did ye give 'em what-for?
english.complete:

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.

english.title: Legging It
english.objective: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
english.detail:
We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.

If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

english.detail:

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.

english.objective: Slay 5 Sickly Refugees and 5 Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.
english.detail:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, <Race>.

english.complete:

Can you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.

english.detail:

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Light be with you.

english.detail:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.

english.title: Tomb Weed
english.objective: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
english.progress: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
english.complete:
Most glorious indeed!

<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>

Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!

A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.

english.title: Seeking Refuge
english.objective: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
english.detail:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

english.title: Seeking Refuge
english.objective: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in Brill.
english.complete:
Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.

Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.
